_note: Phase 2 draft. Generic public knowledge taxonomy: what engineering knowledge a resource represents. Each resource gets exactly one primary domain and sub-domain. Wording is the atlas's own; it is not a reproduction of any organisation's internal classification.

items.label: Products, systems & assets
items.summary: Knowledge about engineered things across their lifecycle.

children.label: Product & asset structure
children.summary: Geometry, decomposition, topology and configuration of products, plants and buildings.

children.label: Product & asset information
children.summary: Catalogues, classifications, nameplates and properties of parts, products and assets.

children.label: Requirements & performance indicators
children.summary: Requirements, specifications, KPIs and acceptance criteria.

children.label: Systems, functions & autonomy
children.summary: Functional and logical architecture of systems, including autonomous and robotic systems.

children.label: Behaviour, tasks & simulation
children.summary: Behaviour, tasks and simulation or analysis models.

children.label: Manufacturing processes & methods
children.summary: Production processes, resources, routings and traceability of produced items.

children.label: Interfaces & communication
children.summary: Device functions, commands, protocols and data interfaces.

children.label: Operational & sensor data
children.summary: Observations, telemetry, IoT and usage data from products and assets in operation.

children.label: Technical documentation & visuals
children.summary: Manuals, technical documents, drawings and visual representations.

items.label: Organisations, people & processes
items.summary: Knowledge about who does what, how and with which skills.

children.label: Organisations & people
children.summary: Companies, teams, roles and persons.

children.label: Business processes & workflows
children.summary: Processes, procedures and workflows of organisations.

children.label: Skills & competences
children.summary: Skills, qualifications and know-how.

children.label: Projects & programmes
children.summary: Projects, programmes, plans and their deliverables.

items.label: Business, commerce & supply
items.summary: Knowledge about markets, trade and supply.

children.label: Commerce & offers
children.summary: Offers, prices, products for sale and e-commerce data.

children.label: Supply chain & logistics
children.summary: Suppliers, capacities, logistics and supply-chain events.

children.label: Markets & economics
children.summary: Market analysis, economic and financial information.

children.label: Contracts & agreements
children.summary: Contracts, licences and commercial agreements.

items.label: Foundational & scientific knowledge
items.summary: Cross-cutting knowledge that other domains build on.

children.label: Upper & formal ontologies
children.summary: Top-level and mid-level ontologies that ground other models.

children.label: Units, quantities & measurement
children.summary: Units of measure, quantity kinds and dimensions.

children.label: Materials & physical science
children.summary: Materials, their properties and physical phenomena.

children.label: Time, space & geography
children.summary: Temporal concepts, positions, geometry and geospatial information.

children.label: Regulation & legislation
children.summary: Legal acts, regulatory requirements and their identifiers.

children.label: Sustainability & environment
children.summary: Environmental, social and lifecycle impact knowledge.

children.label: Metadata, provenance & cataloguing
children.summary: Describing, cataloguing and tracing data and documents.

children.label: Representation & modelling languages
children.summary: Languages and frameworks for representing knowledge and models.

children.label: Scientific methods & research data
children.summary: Scientific investigations, experiments and research models.
